mapper.sql: id, name, voltage_level, commission_date, run_status, jurisdiction_years, management_level, area_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.voltage_level AS voltageLevel, s.commission_date AS commissionDate, s.run_status AS runStatus, s.jurisdiction_years AS jurisdictionYears, s.management_level AS managementLevel, a.area_name AS areaName, a.admin_level AS areaLevel, a.leader AS areaLeader FROM substation s LEFT JOIN power_area a ON s.area_id = a.id WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSubstations, SUM(CASE WHEN run_status = '运行中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN run_status = '停运' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stopped, SUM(CASE WHEN run_status = '检修中' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS maintenance, AVG(jurisdiction_years) AS avgJurisdictionYears FROM substation WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT voltage_level AS voltageLevel, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(jurisdiction_years), 1) AS avgYears FROM substation WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY voltage_level ORDER BY count ASC
mapper.update:
UPDATE substation
name = #{name}, voltage_level = #{voltageLevel}, commission_date = #{commissionDate}, run_status = #{runStatus}, jurisdiction_years = #{jurisdictionYears}, management_level = #{managementLevel}, area_id = #{areaId}, update_time = NOW()
WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
